title: A Bakery for the Vow
author: Isandro Ishikawa
blurb: Zephyrine Blackwood, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
